name: Dimensionality Reduction Expansion Inventory
summary: Declarative refinement inventory for dimensionality-reduction runtime diagnostics and safeguards.

operations.name: Explained Variance Analysis
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether the projection keeps enough of the original signal.

rewrite.before_summary: Projected features flow downstream without retained-variance evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: An explained-variance analyzer is inserted after projection.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds retained-information evidence for the reduced representation.

operations.name: Crowding Detection
operations.intent: Insert crowding detection before projection consumes upstream structure.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether nearby points stay nearby after projection.

rewrite.before_summary: Projected embeddings flow downstream without neighborhood-preservation evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A crowding detector is inserted after projection.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds local-structure evidence for manifold projections.

operations.name: Reconstruction Error Check
operations.intent: Insert reconstruction-error checking after reconstruction validation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether too much information is lost when reconstructing from the projection.

rewrite.before_summary: Reconstruction validation flows downstream without explicit error magnitude evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A reconstruction-error check is inserted after validation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds information-loss evidence for the projection.

operations.name: Orthogonality Validation
operations.intent: Insert projection-component orthogonality validation before reconstruction validation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether projection components are independent enough for the method's assumptions.

rewrite.before_summary: Projection uses components without explicit orthogonality evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: An orthogonality validator is inserted before projection.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds component-independence evidence before dimensionality reduction.

audit.rationale: Normalizes dimensionality-reduction runtime expansion rules into the provider expansion asset schema.
audit.dejargonized_summary: Projection checks for retained variance, neighbor preservation, reconstruction error, and component orthogonality now use the shared expansion schema.

migration_readiness.rationale: The operations are declared through data/expansions and backed by matcher runtime rules.

references.title: sciona.principal.expansion_rules.dimensionality_reduction
references.note: Runtime rule names and diagnostics in sciona-matcher.
